thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 429 rate detected for service=generator-hotpath-us-east. 60s 429s=32%, queue depth rising rapidly, p95 latency >> SLO. Paging oncall.
Lucas: ack, I'm oncall. tagging Mei and Jorge. noticed autoscaler churn earlier. what's the pool status?
Mei: checking metrics now. gpu-hotpool in us-east at replicas=8 (max). queue size jumped at 2123469800. autoscaler attempted scale three times but hit max_replicas. requests are getting rate-limited downstream with token-bucket errors.
Jorge: looking at router logs. we see a surge of "insufficient_tokens" responses after a deploy at ~2123469600. that deploy changed ratepolicy mappings for several routes.
Support: we are already seeing inbound tickets from org-nimbus and org-spark about 429s and intermittent failures. raising priority.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy completed: PR 4892 by Emily to router-service at 2123469575; rollout to us-east completed at 2123469650.
Emily: I merged 4892 to align route tiers. did we have an extra throttle flag in that change?
Mei: yes — PR 4892 tightened token_bucket allocations for gpu-priority routes. it reduced gpu_token.capacity from 1200/s to 60/s for the hotpath. that explains token drain.
Lucas: that explains the immediate 429 spike. with pool at max we needed fallback to cpu-variant. why didn't fallback pick up traffic?
Jorge: the fallback decision checks both replica availability and a minimum token threshold (was added to prevent noisy failovers). with token_bucket.capacity <100 it refused to fallback. so two misconfigurations combined.
Lucas: plan: 1) revert PR 4892 (router map change) immediately, 2) bump gpu pool max_replicas to 20 temporarily, 3) increase gpu token_bucket to 1500/s, 4) force-enable cpu fallback for the hotpath while we stabilize.
Emily: I can revert the router change now.
Emily: running revert and deploy: `git revert 4892 --no-edit && ./scripts/deploy-router us-east` — deploying.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: revert job queued (job id db-7719). starting rollout.
Jorge: applying temporary autoscaler patch: `infractl pools update gpu-hotpool --region=us-east --max-replicas=20` — applied.
Mei: adjusting ratepolicy: `infractl rate set --name=hotpath-gpu --region=us-east --token-capacity=1500 --token-refill=1500` — change applied.
Jorge: overriding fallback guard via cli: `routerctl set-fallback --route=hotpath --cpu-variant=true --force` — enabled.
Lucas: monitoring: queue depth down from ~9.5k -> ~800 within 90s. 429 rate dropping 32% -> 5% over last 3m. p95 latency trending down.
Support: sending short customer notice: "We observed elevated 429s due to a ratepolicy config change. We've reverted the change and increased fallback/capacity. Expect improved availability. We'll follow up with an RCA." sending to affected orgs now.
ops-lead: good mitigation. please keep the changes in place until tomorrow morning CAE review. Also open an incident ticket and assign to SRE for RCA.
infra-bot: ticket-bot: INCIDENT created INC-2026-7264, severity=2, owner=SRE-oncall.
Mei: follow-ups: add a deploy-time linter that warns when token_bucket.capacity is reduced >10x for any hotpath; add a canary for fallback gating behavior; document token units in router config schema.
Emily: adding PR to rework docs and add a deploy gate: PR 4901.
Jorge: adding temporary alert: if autoscaler.max_replicas==current_replicas and queue_depth>1000 -> page SRE.
Lucas: handoff: Priors night shift starts at 2123470300, handing to Jorge for next 3h monitoring. summary: revert applied (router), gpu max replicas bumped, token bucket restored to higher capacity, forced cpu fallback enabled. initial stabilization looks good.
Jorge: ack handoff. I'll monitor and post periodic updates.
Support: customers notified and we have two engineers on the support threads for org-nimbus/org-spark. will escalate if new reports.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Severity-2 -> Mitigated. auto-ticket INC-2026-7264 created. Please file RCA within 72h.
Lucas: closing note: root cause combo = aggressive ratepolicy change + a strict fallback guard. outcome: queued requests, token drain -> 429s. corrective actions: revert, autoscaler headroom, token tuning, deploy gates, and alerts.
Jorge: scheduling short blameless postmortem meeting in 24h.
incident-bot: This thread will be archived when ticket updated.
